initial_selection: uniform random; shared by both arms within seed
features: TF-IDF (1,2), min_df=2, sublinear_tf=True, max_features=20000; refitted on observed labels/text only at each step
evaluation: single fixed validation split; no official test metrics
annotation_cost: budgets count training labels only; validation and calibration have additional fixed labels
scope: offline pool-based simulation, not a human annotation study
